name: Scales 'N' Tails Charters
description: Captain Steve welcomes you to Scales 'N' Tails Charters in Gulf Shores, Alabama. We offer some of the finest saltwater fishing in the world. Our Inshore/Near Shore fishing charters are family-friendly, with safe equipment, sure to reel in a fantastic day! Scales 'N' Tails loves when Mom & Dad bring the kids to experience an offshore fishing trip of a lifetime. Our charters are renowned for safety as our #1 priority, paying close attention to changing weather conditions and making you and your loved ones feel as comfortable as possible. Our offshore trips are more than just catch & release, and our Gulf Shores fishing charters speak volumes to why we hold 21 5-star reviews on Google, 60+ 5-star reviews on Facebook and 45 5-star reviews on Trip Advisor. We use the finest equipment that a beginner or seasoned fisherman can use. It is a perfect way to create a passion for current and new generations. We aren't in the business just to get your money; if we can't have a fun, safe, smooth day offshore, we don't go. Once we get offshore, there are plenty of fish to catch, and the selection is vast! The fish we catch are great to eat and we even offer cooking tips (or we can package/send you and your fish to local restaurants for them to cook). With over 40 years in the fishing charter business, we have plenty to teach those wanting to learn and have a great time. I'm a lifelong fisherman, having spent over 35 of my over 50 years of fishing, in saltwater. I have been fortunate to learn from many great fishermen in my life and I enjoy passing on what I've learned to kids or adults who are wanting and willing to learn.
